description: First-run device access checklist shared by the Android host (apps/android) and the shared web UI (apps/web). Android reports these item ids in this order (notifications only on API 33+); the web UI owns the copy for each id. Every item must be backed by code that uses the permission.

notAsked.android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC: Normal permission granted at install; used by the device unlock prompt.
notAsked.android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT: Normal permission granted at install; used by the device unlock prompt on old Android versions.
notAsked.android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS: Grogoni only reads the phonebook; it never edits contacts.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE: No Grogoni code reads it; the default SMS role grants it, so sending and reading do not depend on it here.
notAsked.android.permission.CALL_PHONE: tel: links open the phone's dialer, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO: The Android host grants the page no microphone access, so nothing records audio.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES: Attachments use the system picker, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO: Attachments use the system picker, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO: Attachments use the system picker, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE: Attachments use the system picker, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Attachments use the system picker, which needs no permission.
notAsked.android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG: Grogoni does not write shared storage.
